rule.description: A function whose field accesses on a foreign workspace type dominate its field accesses on its own home type: at least 10 foreign field reads, leading the home count by at least 4. Free functions have no home type, so every workspace-ADT field read they perform counts as foreign. An allow/expect directive can discard the emitted warning but not the relation itself: fires suppressed that way are still reported as matches.

checks.description: Detect debouncer methods whose body reads the shared debounce state field by field instead of asking the state's own type for an account.
checks.detected_relation: Debouncer method -> DebounceDataInner queue/root/event bookkeeping reached through Arc<SharedDebounceData<Mutex<...>>> guards
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: The function is hosted on the debouncer facade but its interest lies almost entirely in another type's data; the shared state may change layout while these narrations still sit on the facade.

matches.evidence: Checker reports the function at notify-debouncer-full/src/lib.rs:712 reaching into `DebounceDataInner` data more than through the data of its own type: it reads the queue table and per-queue pending/head events, pending rename and rescan events, buffered errors, roots, recursive modes and the debounce timeout.

Checker reports the function at notify-debouncer-full/src/lib.rs:617 reaching into `DebounceDataInner` data more than through the data of its own type: the stale-queue gauge loops over queue keys against the root list, reads queue entries and pending event counts, the cache, pending rename/rescan events and buffered errors.

checks.description: Detect module-level rendering helpers that format a foreign event record field by field.
checks.detected_relation: free function in notify-debouncer-mini -> notify::Event kind/paths/attrs fields
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: A free function has no home type, so all eleven of its field accesses target the event record; narrating a record is the record's own responsibility, not the intake path's.

matches.evidence: Checker reports the function at notify-debouncer-mini/src/lib.rs:250 reaching into `notify::Event` data more than through the data of its own type: it reads the event kind, the attached paths, path count, first/last path and the attrs info and process id, then branches on the same records.

checks.description: Detect backend loop methods that render installed watch entries field by field.
checks.detected_relation: inotify EventLoop method -> Watch descriptor/mask/dereference flags and WatchMetadata user/recursion/reported-path fields
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: Every line of the watch-table dump is built from the Watch record's fields while the loop itself contributes only the iteration; the record could describe itself and the loop could ask.

matches.evidence: Checker reports the function at notify/src/inotify.rs:877 reaching into `inotify::Watch` data more than through the data of its own type: it reads directory/dereference flags, user/recursive metadata, watch descriptors and masks and reported paths for every installed watch.

checks.description: Detect rescan-time helpers that pair and narrate stored per-path entries field by field.
checks.detected_relation: poll WatchData method -> PathData mtime/content-hash/last-check fields held in the all_path_data table
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: The pairing logic compares foreign records' stored clocks and hashes; the comparison reads like the record's own behavior but is glued onto the rescan trigger.

matches.evidence: Checker reports the function at notify/src/poll.rs:313 reaching into `poll::data::PathData` data more than through the data of its own type: it reads both records' content hashes, mtimes and last-check instants to build alias pairs and same-clock judgements.

excluded.reason: Largest pre-existing off-balance function (9 foreign vs 9 home field accesses) but below every threshold: 9 < 10 required foreign reads, so it does not match the relation.
Pre-existing dispatch over watch records is home-dominant in the analysis; not a match of the injected relation.
8 foreign vs 5 home field accesses, below the 10-foreign threshold; the rule intentionally tolerates genuinely mixed access.
